name: Mini Hof Sommer
beschreibung: The campsite Mini Hof Sommer is located in a quiet, rural setting in Tirol. The mountain scenery with its hiking trails and cycling routes shapes the landscape. The site is surrounded by meadows and forests. The amenities include sanitary facilities and electrical hookups for motorhomes and tents. The campsite is a seasonal operation and open during the summer months. Guests can expect simple and nature-oriented accommodation. The peaceful atmosphere and the proximity to nature are characteristic. The site is suitable for nature lovers and families.
